offers.brandNames: SOLO X LEAF - educational tour in Paris
offers.title: LEAF
offers.longDesc:
SOLO and LEAF invite your children aged 15–18 to join a 7-day educational tour in Paris


The offer includes hotel accommodation with breakfast, airport and Disneyland transfers, visits to universities (AUP, Sciences Po, GOBELINS, ESCP) and UNESCO Headquarters, cultural activities (Notre-Dame, Seine River Cruise, BnF, Paris mysteries tour), startup experiences (Station F, Startup Challenge, Cité des Sciences), and tickets to Disneyland Paris


Places are limited


Tour Itinerary


Day 1: Arrival, Welcome Session, and introduction to the week's program

Day 2: The American University of Paris - campus tour; UNESCO Headquarters - introduction to the work of the international organization and career opportunities; Notre-Dame de Paris - exploring Gothic architecture and the history of its restoration; Seine River Cruise - discovering Paris from the river

Day 3: Sciences Po - visit to one of Europe's most prestigious social sciences institutions; Cité des Sciences - exploring AI, space, and the planetarium; Science & Innovation Challenge

Day 4: GOBELINS Paris - visit to one of the leading schools of visual arts and animation; Station F - tour of the world's largest startup campus; Startup Challenge - students will develop a business idea and present it in a short presentation

Day 5: ESCP Business School - visit to one of Europe's oldest business schools; Bibliothèque Nationale de France - visit to the National Library of France; “Paris, Between Crimes and Mysteries” - discovering the history of Paris through storytelling; Farewell Dinner

Day 6: Full day at Disneyland Paris

Day 7: Departure


Travel Details

Age: 15–18 years

Dates: February 21–27, 2027

Group: 5 students + 2 chaperones


Price: €3,955 (includes hotel accommodation, transfers, activities, and a Disneyland ticket; airfare, insurance, and meals are not included)
